🧩 Trivia Data Builder

Makes the Pingway Trivia word bank (trivia_bank.json) from XIVAPI in English, French, German and Japanese — right here in your browser.

  1. Press Build and keep this tab open (it takes a few minutes).
  2. When it's done, trivia_bank.json downloads.
  3. Upload it to the bot server as data/trivia_bank.json (replace the old one) and restart the bot.
  4. Optional: check the file's SHA-256 on the server (sha256sum data/trivia_bank.json) — it must match the one shown below.

Build a new one when FFXIV adds new content (a patch with new jobs, duties, mounts, minions or items).

Ready.
